newsitem.title: UK: TENNIS SPOTLIGHT-BRIEF PROFILE OF BORIS BECKER.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS SPOTLIGHT-BRIEF PROFILE OF BORIS BECKER.

text.p: Brief profile of Boris Becker, 6-3 6-2 6-3 winner of a first round men's singles match against Marcos Aurelio Gorriz of Spain at Wimbledon on Tuesday.
Becker, making his 14th consecutive appearance at the grasscourt grand slam tournament, looked at ease throughout the match on his favourite surface where he has won three times.
Wimbledon is the only grand slam tournament he has never missed since he started his grand slam career here in 1984.
This was his 65th win at Wimbledon after being forced to retire from last year's tournament in the third round with a ruptured tendon in his right wrist.
"I always broke my opponent's serve quite early. Then I kept holding, and it was a rather easy win," said Becker.
Seeded: 8. Age: 29. Plays: right-handed. Weight: 85kg. Height: 1.90m. Ranking: 18. Tournament wins: 49. Head-to-head after Tuesday's match (win-loss) 1-0. Career prize money: $23.8 million.
Next opponent: Dominik Hrbaty (Slovakia) or Thomas Johansson (Sweden).
